description: This Swift source file defines the OpenClawChatViewModel class, which manages the state and interactions for a chat UI in an OpenClaw-based application. It handles sending messages, managing sessions, choosing models and thinking levels, processing transport events, and maintaining message history.

classes.name: OpenClawChatViewModel
classes.description: A view model class for managing chat UI state and interactions, including message handling, session management, and communication with the transport layer.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the view model with session key, transport, optional initial thinking level, and callbacks.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the chat session data and initializes the view model.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Performs sending the current input message.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of sessions.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches to a different chat session.

methods.name: selectModel
methods.description: Selects the model for chat responses.

methods.name: addImageAttachment
methods.description: Adds an image attachment from data.
